mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% within 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 (index 2017=100) during supply chain disruptions signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% year-over-year signals rising inflation expectations, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 146 million indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS > 146 million, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
